## What changed

- Added `src/data/persistence.ts` — reads `navigator.storage.persisted()`, requests persistence once per `PersistenceClient`, and maps granted/denied/unsupported/thrown paths to `persistent` or `best-effort` without throwing.
- Added `src/data/storageEstimate.ts` — reads `navigator.storage.estimate()`, derives usage/quota/ratio/percentage, warns strictly above 80%, safely handles invalid/zero/missing estimates, and formats byte counts.
- Added `src/data/useBroadcastSync.ts` — renderer-neutral BroadcastChannel event schema, payload validation, channel wrapper, echo suppression, and close/unsubscribe lifecycle. No React or network access.
- Added `src/features/shelf/useBroadcastSync.ts` — the React hook adapter, deliberately outside `src/data` because the existing data-layer boundary test forbids React there. It leaves the pure sync module at the expected `src/data/useBroadcastSync.ts` path.
- Added `src/features/shelf/StorageStatus.tsx` — persistent/best-effort badge, usage/quota/percentage, accessible progress meter, >80% warning, unsupported-API fallback, and a `backupAction` slot.
- Updated `CaseShelfPage.tsx` — loads persistence/estimate state, requests persistence on first case creation only, broadcasts committed creates/updates, re-reads the repository on remote mutations, cancels stale in-flight refreshes after a newer local write, and never touches dialog draft state.
- Updated `CaseShelf.tsx`/`shelf.css` — renders the storage strip above the grid and styles it with existing tokens.
- Added 26 tests across the four required test files.

handoff.summary: Implemented persistent-storage requests, usage/quota warnings, and cross-tab case invalidation; required tests, typecheck, full suite, lint, formatting, coverage, and build pass.
decisions: The pure BroadcastChannel/event layer stays in src/data/useBroadcastSync.ts to preserve the data-layer no-React boundary; the React hook lives in src/features/shelf/useBroadcastSync.ts.
Persistence is requested only after the first successful case creation and cached once per PersistenceClient.
Remote mutations trigger an authoritative repository re-read; dialog state is untouched so unsaved drafts survive, and local writes invalidate stale in-flight remote refreshes.
StorageStatus exposes a backupAction slot but does not implement backup export/import, which remains out of scope.
